headline: SFG @ ARI matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is SFG 4.30 at ARI 4.69, with a projected total of 8.99. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward ARI: SFG moved -0.53 runs while ARI moved +0.15, changing the projected margin by -0.68 runs. The projected total fell -0.38, which points to a lower-run game script than the earliest saved read. NRFI probability rose +6.3%, so the first-inning read became more pitcher-friendly early. Pitching context: Eduardo Rodriguez has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.4 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Ketel Marte, Casey Schmitt, Luis Arraez, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Max Kepler, Matt Chapman because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
